domain.text: vmethod worker adoption of legacy bash records, including safe nested paths, verification, skip reporting, and legacy Estimate snapshots.

impressions.text: The task was to support importing legacy SpaceRocks and vecs worker records without weakening verification, and the delivery added safe nested-path handling, worktree-keyed records, and explicit skip reasons.
The worker reported broad verification passing, including 777 tests across 51 files after merging dev, plus green CI on the final head.

Review caught that legacy PRs lack the opening-estimate marker, preventing adoption; the worker addressed this with a legacy-only snapshot from the linked issue’s current Estimate and a specific skip when none exists.

The live smoke then reported merged PRs, a probe, and an ambiguous link as skips; the remaining candidate was skipped because its linked issue had no Estimate, and no successful live adoption was shown.
